title: WHERE ARE THE HUMANS? A SCOPING REVIEW OF FAIRNESS IN MULTI-AGENT AI SYSTEMS

bias_targets.methodology: Synthesizing research (e.g., Bai et al., 2024) that assesses fairness through benchmarks revealing patterns of discrimination, such as AI agents assigning technical or leadership roles based on perceived gender.
Synthesizing research that assesses fairness through benchmarks revealing patterns of discrimination, such as AI agents assigning technical or leadership roles based on perceived ethnicity.
Reviewing literature (e.g., Ball et al., 2025) that compares embedded political opinions across different Large Language Models to highlight the risks of model dependency.

Discussing studies (e.g., Leng, 2024) that evaluate how cognitive biases (such as irrational loss aversion) in models vary significantly depending on the input language (e.g., English versus Spanish or French).
